1 · Intro

When to use it.

Changes to an employee's job or funding may require an update to their payroll costing in Oracle. Learn the events that should send you to check costing.

Use this whenA job, team, or funding change happens to one of your employees.

2 · Walk through

Events that need a costing check.

Check off each item as you read.

Watch-outs

  • Costing follows an employee who changes business units. The HCM receiving the transfer reviews the COA and POET costing so payroll is charged to the new funding source.
  • Most of these scenarios don't have walkthroughs recorded yet. Ask your FUM (financial unit manager) when unsure.
  • Salary distributed across multiple funding sources and cross-unit award compensation may become reference resources rather than core training. To be decided by the HCM group.

Official documentation

Vendor documentation describes the standard process. Vanderbilt's setup, codes, and rules in this course take priority.

HCM Academy job aid · Costing Management

When costing must be updated

Use when: A job, team, or funding change happens to one of your employees. · System: Oracle HCM

  1. How to check costing for any event below.
  2. New hire: is the costing right for every funding source?
  3. A change within the work unit: is the funding still correct?
  4. Transfer to another work unit or business unit: the new area updates costing.
  5. Bonus, lump sum, or interim pay: should it charge a different funding source than salary?
  6. Another business unit funds an award for your employee.
  7. Salary distributed across multiple funding sources.
  8. Before every HCM Transaction Cutoff: check costing for your unit.

Watch-outs

  • Costing follows an employee who changes business units. The HCM receiving the transfer reviews the COA and POET costing so payroll is charged to the new funding source.
  • Most of these scenarios don't have walkthroughs recorded yet. Ask your FUM (financial unit manager) when unsure.
  • Salary distributed across multiple funding sources and cross-unit award compensation may become reference resources rather than core training. To be decided by the HCM group.
